description:
## Dual VoT Patches 1.37.0-dualvot.8.1

### Yandex player button

- Integrates the Yandex translation button with restored thin player controls.
- Uses separate thin legacy and bold modern icons so each matches its player style.
- Compacts all five optional controls in portrait and gives them balanced spacing in landscape, in both player styles.

### Validation

- Android patch bundle compiled successfully.
- Both player styles and five-button portrait/landscape layouts were tested on a device.
- Required Dual VoT integration sources, metadata, and bundle manifest were verified.

### Included base

- Based on stable Morphe Patches 1.37.0.
- Includes both the built-in Google/other translation and Yandex translation with mutually exclusive player controls.
